description: Validates rejection of out-of-order sequence gaps, stale source_generations, stale snapshot_sequences, and resurrection attempts after an EN5c source_generation purge.

steps.description: Reject out-of-order snapshot_sequence=4 when high_water_sequence is 1.
Reject snapshot_sequence=2 carrying stale source_generation=1 when active_source_generation is 2.
Commit snapshot_sequence=2 purging SRC_ALPHA through source_generation=3.
Reject modified manifest replayed at stale snapshot_sequence=1 (< high_water_sequence=2).
Reject snapshot_sequence=3 attempting to resurrect purged source_generation=3.
